name: Scorbunny
description: Scorbunny, the Rabbit Pokémon. Able to evolve into Raboot. A Fire type.
pokedex_entries: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.
It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.
